name: Minimal
longDescription: Clean lines, neutral palettes, and quality basics. Embrace simplicity with monochrome pieces and refined silhouettes that never go out of style.

name: Luxury
longDescription: Sophisticated and polished with premium fabrics and impeccable tailoring. Think classic cuts, luxe materials, and understated glamour that exudes confidence.

name: Eccentric
longDescription: Bold self-expression through unique patterns, vibrant colors, and unexpected combinations. Artistic, playful, and unapologetically individual.

name: Business
longDescription: Sharp, structured, and professionally polished. Blazers, tailored trousers, and sophisticated separates that command respect in any boardroom.

name: Vanilla
longDescription: Soft, approachable, and effortlessly fresh. Light neutrals, gentle textures, and cozy pieces in cream, beige, and white tones.

name: Sporty
longDescription: Athletic meets everyday style with functional comfort. Think joggers, sneakers, performance fabrics, and pieces that move with you from gym to street.

name: Edgy
longDescription: Daring and fashion-forward with bold statements and modern edge. Leather, asymmetric cuts, and pieces that push boundaries and turn heads.

name: Bohemian
longDescription: Free-spirited and relaxed with flowing silhouettes and earthy tones. Natural fabrics, vintage-inspired prints, and effortless boho charm.

name: Classic
longDescription: Timeless sophistication with quiet luxury appeal. Preppy staples, heritage pieces, and understated elegance that whispers rather than shouts.

name: Mystery Style
longDescription: Surprise me! Let the AI discover your unique style through your preferences. Every style journey is different—embrace the unexpected.
